decisions.claim: B can go to the supermarket today
decisions.reason: Turn 3 'Yes, we can' is A's explicit confirmation that both A and B can go to the supermarket today; 'we' corefers to include B.

decisions.claim: A and B share awareness of a coupon that will be past due in three days
decisions.reason: Definite NP 'the coupon' in Turn 1 presupposes shared awareness between A and B of a specific coupon past due in three days.

decisions.claim: B is aware of a coupon that will expire in three days
decisions.reason: c3 is a weaker projection of c2: 'B is aware' follows from 'A and B share awareness.' The definite presupposition in c2 already establishes B's awareness; c3 adds no new information.

decisions.claim: B is in a position where A and B can go to the supermarket together
decisions.reason: Turn 3 'Yes, we can' establishes that A and B are jointly in a position to go to the supermarket together. This is a genuine E2 presupposition from 'we' requiring co-presence/availability of both parties, distinct from c1 which only states B's individual ability.
